output_commit_note: Every production output remains byte-identical to the accepted starting commit; the commit containing this report changes evidence and plans only.

snapshot_method.membership: git ls-files -z plus recursive files throughout the physical development root, including ignored non-cache files and nested worktrees; tracked paths remain included inside excluded directories.
snapshot_method.measurements: st_mtime_ns, raw byte length, SHA-256, raw Git blob SHA-1 and filtered Git blob identity. Raw hashes are re-read for every snapshot. Unchanged primary-checkout files reuse the initial filtered identity after every .gitattributes hash is rechecked; changed files use git hash-object --stdin-paths. No file is normalized or rewritten for comparison.
snapshot_method.nested_qualification: Physical-root snapshots include the three separate Claude worktrees. Each nested checkout has an independently measured HEAD, branch and status before and after every command. Nested raw hashes and mtimes are observations; parent-checkout filters are not used as nested filtered identities.
snapshot_method.snapshot_digest_serialization: SHA-256 of json.dumps(states, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True).encode('utf-8').

findings_and_resolutions: All three production commands succeeded with 99 distinct expected outputs. MAM-with-doc touched 62 paths, authored generation touched 21, and the historical comparison touched 13; every output retained its frozen raw bytes and Git blob.

The historical command left filter.js, style.css and the change-log font untouched because their conditional writers found current files. The font source and destination also match byte for byte under an independent check.

All 144 permanent historical JSON files remain unchanged at 84,572,003 bytes and match the authoritative manifest. The five named boundaries and the unpinned boundary follow the authoritative release order.

The original source, immutable Land and current product identities remain separate. Thirteen published paths retain the documented Phase 4 adaptations; the adapted product README and the accepted Phase 6B FOI page are reported separately.
The three nested Claude worktrees remained clean and produced no observed mtime or raw-byte changes during the Phase 6C commands. No production write left the primary MAM-basics checkout.
